scientific_integrity: All mathematical steps supplied in the proof; two executable independent finite checks are included. No independent scientific validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Counts only initially periodic states of exactly mn chips with exactly one firing of each vertex in its least period; no claims for other sectors, fixed points, transient basins or absolute historical priority. Goles–Prisner 2000 related full text unavailable. Finite checks are supplementary.
title: Critical-mass single-pass chip-firing waves on complete bipartite graphs
